Start your future with EE - Where your voice could be the start of something big

At EE, you're part of something bigger. You'll make friends, learn new skills, and build confidence every day. We're proud to be inclusive and welcome people from all backgrounds - because everyone belongs here.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Môrwell Talent Solutions is delighted to be working with a well-established organisation in Cardiff City Centre to recruit a Credit Controller to join its busy Head Office finance team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller to join a supportive and collaborative finance function within a successful business. You will take ownership of customer accounts, help drive timely payments and play an important role in maintaining strong cash flow, whilst building positive and professional relationships with customers.

The Role

Working as part of an established finance team, you will be responsible for managing outstanding debt, monitoring customer accounts and proactively resolving queries to ensure payments are received within agreed terms.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing and monitoring customer accounts and outstanding balances across the sales ledger.
- Proactively chasing overdue invoices by telephone and email.
- Maintaining professional, positive relationships with customers whilst ensuring payments are made in a timely manner.
- Reconciling customer accounts and investigating discrepancies.
- Allocating incoming payments accurately and efficiently.
- Reviewing aged debt and identifying accounts requiring further action.
- Investigating and resolving invoice and account queries.
- Preparing aged debtor reports and providing updates on collection activity.
- Supporting month-end processes and wider finance team activities.
- Working closely with colleagues across the business to resolve issues and improve credit control processes.

About You

You will have previous experience working within Credit Control or a similar accounts receivable role and be comfortable managing customer accounts within a busy finance environment.

We are looking for someone who is confident communicating with customers, commercially minded and capable of balancing effective debt recovery with maintaining positive working relationships.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in Credit Control or Accounts Receivable.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills.
- A proactive and organised approach to managing outstanding debt.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to investigate and resolve queries.
- The confidence to manage your own workload and prioritise effectively.
- Strong Excel skills and experience using accounting or finance systems.
- A team-focused approach with the ability to work collaboratively across the finance function.

The Package
- Salary circa £30,000, depending on experience.
- Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week.
- Hybrid working of offer.
- 25 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays.
- Opportunity to join an established and supportive finance team.

If you are an experienced Credit Controller looking for your next opportunity within a well-established organisation offering hybrid working and a collaborative team environment, we would love to hear from you.

Contact Môrwell Talent Solutions today for a confidential discussion.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented Sales Administrator to join our team in St Mellons.

This is a key role within the business, taking responsibility for the full sales administration process, from initial customer enquiries and quotations through to order processing, dispatch and delivery. You will work closely with customers and colleagues across Sales, Production, Warehouse, Logistics and Finance to ensure orders are processed accurately, deadlines are met and customers receive an excellent level of service.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage customer orders from initial enquiry through to final delivery.
- Prepare quotations, order confirmations, invoices and relevant sales documentation.
- Monitor order progress, coordinate dispatch and proactively follow up on outstanding actions.
- Liaise with customers and internal departments to ensure orders are fulfilled accurately and on time.
- Prepare export and shipping documentation where required.
- Maintain accurate customer and order records and assist with sales reporting.
- Handle telephone enquiries, general correspondence and other office administration.

About You

You will be exceptionally organised, have excellent attention to detail and take pride in seeing tasks through to completion. You will be confident communicating with different departments, managing competing priorities and taking the initiative to resolve issues without needing constant supervision.

We are looking for someone who is dependable, customer-focused and comfortable taking ownership of their workload.

Ideally, you will have:

Experience in sales administration, order processing or a similar role.

Good IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Office.

Experience with Sage 200, Salesforce and export documentation.

Experience with these systems and export processes is advantageous but not essential, as training can be provided for the right candidate. A positive attitude, strong organisational skills and a willingness to learn are what matter most.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary (phone number removed) depending on experience

- Private healthcare
- BHSF Health Cash Plan
- Training, development, and career progression

title: Service Administrator
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established commercial vehicle dealership in Cardiff for a Service Administrator to join their busy service department. Reporting directly to the Branch Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring workshop operations run smoothly, customers are kept informed throughout the repair process and all completed work is invoiced accurately and efficiently.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administration skills who enjoys working closely with customers, technicians and service teams.

The Role

As Service Administrator, your responsibilities will include:
- Processing and invoicing completed workshop jobs on a daily basis.
- Auditing job cards and associated paperwork to ensure accuracy and compliance.
- Acting as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the service and repair process.
- Handling telephone and face-to-face enquiries in a professional and friendly manner.
- Confirming payment responsibility for repairs including retail, warranty and contract work.
- Carrying out customer account checks and obtaining purchase order numbers where required.
- Planning and coordinating MOT bookings whilst liaising with customers and relevant authorities.
- Managing customer defect reporting procedures.
- Arranging sublet work with external suppliers and specialist contractors.
- Planning and maintaining workshop schedules and diary management.
- Supporting the service desk during busy periods and holiday cover.
- Conducting follow-up customer service calls.
- Maintaining high dealership operating standards and contributing to customer satisfaction targets.

What We're Looking For
- Previous administration experience within a busy service, automotive or customer-focused environment.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills.
- Strong organisational and time management abilities.
- Ability to build and maintain positive relationships with both customers and colleagues.
- Confident working under pressure and managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
- Good IT skills with experience using Microsoft Office packages.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable Experience
- Automotive, commercial vehicle or engineering industry experience.
- Basic technical understanding of vehicle maintenance and repair processes.
- Knowledge of Operator Licence regulations.
- Experience using Autoline or a similar dealer management system.
- Previous workshop planning or service administration experience.

What's On Offer?
- Full-time permanent position.
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 07:00am - 16:30pm (including a 30-minute unpaid break)
Alternate Saturdays: 08:00am - 12:00pm (included within salary)
- Join a respected and established commercial vehicle business.
- Varied role with customer interaction and workshop support.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.

title: Training Course Coordination Administrator
description:
Training Course Coordination Administrator

Location: Hybrid/Cardiff office 4 days a week
Salary: £26,395 per annum, DOE + Excellent Benefits!
Contract Type: Permanent, full time
What We Can Offer You: 25 Days Annual Leave (Pro-Rata for Part-time and Fixed-Term Roles), Additional Holiday Purchase, Hybrid Working, Life Assurance, Vitality Private Healthcare, Subsidised Gym Memberships, Cycle to Work scheme, Discount Vouchers and Access to Wellbeing Resources

Why do we want you

Astutis (part of Wilmington plc) is looking for a highly organised and customer-focused individual who is passionate about delivering an exceptional learner experience.

In this role, you'll act as a key point of contact for learners throughout their qualification journey, providing support from registration and course access through to assessment, examination and certification.

You'll be confident managing multiple priorities, coordinating examination processes, maintaining accurate learner records and ensuring communications are delivered clearly and professionally to both learners and stakeholders.

Most importantly, you'll enjoy helping people succeed, proactively supporting learners at key milestones, answering queries and ensuring they have the guidance, resources and encouragement needed to achieve their qualifications.

Please note: To complete your application, you will be redirected to Wilmington plc s career site.

At Wilmington plc, we celebrate individuality and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. As a Disability Confident employer, we shortlist all applicants who meet the essential role criteria and guarantee an interview for candidates with disabilities who meet these criteria. For reasonable adjustments or to apply under our interview guarantee scheme, please use the contact details provided once you have clicked apply !

Job purpose, tasks and responsibilities

You will be responsible for:
- Support online learners throughout their learning journey.
- Manage exam registrations, bookings, scheduling and communications.
- Guide learners through assessment and exam milestones.
- Deliver against SLAs, KPIs and learner administration deadlines.
- Build strong relationships with Sales Account Managers to deliver an excellent learner experience.
- Act as the main point of contact for learners from enrolment through to certification.
- Support learners requiring additional help, re-sits or extensions.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of operational processes and best practice.
- Maintain accurate learner records using internal systems and technology.
- Deliver exceptional customer service in all communications.
- Provide team support and cover during busy periods and colleague absences.

What's the Best Thing About This Role

You will have the opportunity to directly influence learner success.

You'll be more than an administrator or coordinator; you'll become a trusted point of contact, supporting people from registration through to certification.

Seeing learners overcome challenges, pass their assessments and achieve their qualifications provides a genuine sense of purpose and achievement, while working within a customer-focused team dedicated to delivering an exceptional learning experience.

What s the Most Challenging Thing About This Role

Successfully managing multiple learners, deadlines and stakeholder requirements at the same time while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

The role requires someone who can switch between responding to learner queries, coordinating examinations, updating systems, working with awarding bodies, and supporting internal teams, all while ensuring every learner receives a high level of personalised support.

Essential and desirable capabilities

To be successful in this role, you must have:
- Previous experience in a customer service, client support, operations, coordination, or administration role.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
- Solid understanding and knowledge of customer service principles and standards.
- Knowledge of principles and practices of Sales, and how this relates to after-sales customer support and care.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
- Experience using CRM or administrative systems.
- A customer-first mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional service.
- Ability to build positive relationships with customers, learners, and internal stakeholders.

It would be great if you had:
- Experience working within a training, learning, education, or professional services environment.
- Understanding of training and professional certification processes.
- Familiarity with awarding bodies such as NEBOSH, IOSH, or IEMA.
- Experience supporting key accounts or managing a client portfolio.
- Knowledge of post-sales customer support and customer success principles.
- We know it s not a skill, but the successful candidate must have permission to work in the role s location by the start of their employment.

Before you go

About us

Astutis is a market leader in workplace health, safety, and environmental training, helping organisations create safer, healthier work environments. As part of Wilmington plc, we are committed to delivering high-quality courses and outstanding customer service.

Join us and do Work That Means Something

At Wilmington plc, we help global customers to do the right business in the right way - providing trusted data, insights, and education to navigate the Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) landscape.

When you join us, you ll not only make a real difference for our customers, you ll also enjoy flexibility through hybrid working and benefit from a wide range of learning, career, and development opportunities.

Whether you're just starting out, returning to work after a break, or looking to take your next step, you ll be doing work with meaning.

Join us and make a real difference. Click on APPLY today!
